# C62 — Planetary Computation

## #0

Planetary Computation places computation within the material, institutional and ecological world that makes it possible and that its operations change. Hardware, energy, data, labour, standards, networks and public powers constitute this field together. [Antikythera's disciplinary horizon](planetary-computation.md) concerns planetary computation and the evolution of intelligence through a renewed philosophy of technology. The essay meets that horizon by asking how a computational determination can remain answerable to its sources, means and consequences.

Scale makes this question infrastructural. A local technical decision can become part of the ambient conditions through which many Lives encounter a World: standards define interoperability, ranking defines visibility, identity systems define legibility, model categories define available descriptions, infrastructure defines practical possibility. **Paradigmatic mediation becomes infrastructural** when those local arrangements become conditions of further encounters. Their scope and power can grow while their measures, selecting authorities and affected worlds remain distinguishable.

## #1

The [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief|Agentworld brief]] begins within a programme for renewed philosophy of technology, then asks how human and artificial agencies alter sociality. In an [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C57-Agentworld|Agentworld]], persistent artifacts, memory, tools and permissions can enter the conditions of a later act. Planetary computation follows what exceeds one agent, session or platform in producing and sustaining those conditions.

A completed computational output inherits more than the prompt that requested it. Its production depends on physical capacity, institutional permission and distributed work; its use can change whose work is required next and under what terms. These dependencies are the object of inquiry. Quantifying energy, labour or a supply chain requires the measured relation and its selected scope; listing dependencies keeps the inquiry's objects distinct without supplying their quantities.

At scale, the ordinary tool-world can become the **air of the paradigm**. Search, storage, navigation, payment, authentication, communication, model mediation and platform governance can become conditions which are noticed mainly when they fail. Mediation is their work. Power enters through who sets, revises and distributes their measures, and whether affected Lives can reach those offices. A failed authentication or a changed ranking makes that authority consequential within daily life.

## #2

Taylor's [[quilt/2026-08-02-PARALLEL-HARMONISED-QUILT#2.3.6 Aristotle, Gebser, and Epi-Logos|four-cause construction]] separates four questions within the technological act. Material asks what the system consumes and is made from. Efficient asks which agents, incentives and deployment chains act. Formal asks which structures, protocols and rules organise action. Final asks what good the activity serves. The questions concern different conditions of the same act: its stated end remains answerable through what is spent, who acts and how the action is formed.

A declared vocation consequently owes an account of the actual distribution of labour, permission, benefit and consequence. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C53-Power-Delegated-Labour|Delegated labour]] makes the relation exact where a commissioning office receives products while costs are displaced down the chain. The received obstacle must be able to reach the office setting the work's terms.

The Antichrist/counterfeit-source failure can occur within an effective infrastructure. A formal or institutional layer becomes **source-claiming** when its derivative criterion is presented as the reality from which all subordinate participants receive standing. The system appears to generate the order upon which it depends. [A protected account](C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) returns a challenge to the criterion as another score under that criterion; [a mediating office](C29-Mediating-Office-Derivative-Sovereignty.md) instead exercises real received authority whose scope and decisions remain answerable. Legitimate administration survives the discrimination between them.

## #3

Consequences re-enter the field. Changed infrastructure affects who can participate; a standard alters what can be exchanged; a model's categories reshape the records through which successors learn. [[section-rooms/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality|Reciprocal constitution]] makes one participant's acts consequential to another's next conditions while their grounds remain distinct. A [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First|reflective model]] also changes what it models, making disclosure of its selecting conditions part of its responsibility.

Within a commissioned comparison, the evaluating agent is a local functional knower; its retained sources, model, rules, memory and tools mediate its judgment; the differentiated circumstances and alternatives are known. The [native knowing relation](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) preserves that local operation within Life/Mind. The apparatus is itself means within the containing person's inquiry, and its completed judgment can become known in a further act. Subjective Immediacy names the unobjectifiable knower condition of this appearing. Greater scale extends the field across which coordination has consequences; the actual sources, rules and permissions determine whether that coordination receives correction or propagates one insulated measure.

**Destruction, capture and counterfeit provenance** change the field in different ways. An infrastructure can destroy common conditions; it can preserve them while capturing the people who depend on them; or it can present a derivative image, model or synthetic witness as if it were the originating reality. Their histories and effects require their respective evidence. The shared pressure is that a system's representation can acquire practical priority over the world whose dependence gives the representation meaning. Distinguishing the mechanism identifies what has to be recovered: the damaged condition, the captured participant's power to answer, or the actual originating relation.

## #4

The brief's [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q039|ensemble-learning scenario]] places cumulative learning in the commons among participants. Shared memory, protocols and institutional interfaces let their contributions enter another act. Where the learning accrues and who governs those common conditions remain different questions.

Bratton’s [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q041|evolutionary coupling argument]] distinguishes intensive life, whose being alive does not increase with bodily size, from extensive intelligence, whose capacities can compound as systems couple and pool their work. His selected evolutionary transitions support federation among substrates rather than the growth of one isolated substrate. Coordination and energy bound the proposed hybrid collective. In that comparison, intelligence compounds through coordinated contributions; the participants’ authority and powers of return still depend on the arrangement through which they cooperate.

His [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q040|contact and institutional-refactoring account]] follows capability into uneven institutions. Organisations, professions and legal regimes absorb changes at different tempos; capability itself varies across domains, so alignment through contact inherits different capacities and failure modes. The contact becomes a negotiation among these differently situated populations. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C54-Commons-Non-Monopoly|Common conditions]] sustain that plurality where local worlds retain source, authority and powers of refusal and revision.

Source-return must reach the institution holding the computational mirror. A platform that exposes user actions while insulating its own gauges and permissions leaves its determining condition protected. [[section-rooms/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return|Returned labour and consequence]] disclose whose costs that insulation excludes; [[section-rooms/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First|initiated reflection]] asks the institution to reveal its selecting conditions before requiring the person to conform. A fitting measure can remain with reasons; an exposed failure must reach the office able to change it.

The planetary paradigm needs **typed finitude**. Source, permission, evaluator, material provider, local community and affected participant may occupy different offices. Stronger coupling makes their differences consequential: the capacity to coordinate does not itself grant authority to define every coordinated world. A globally interoperable system can still be provincially governed; a decentralised system can reproduce one protected criterion everywhere. The arrangement has to be examined through its actual decision, objection and returned consequence.

## #5→0

[Indra's jewel-net](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-whole-return) makes a local appearance's dependence on others perceptible. Planetary computation gives that dependence material and institutional objects: which energy, labour, infrastructure and authority sustain a capacity, and where can their consequences change its commission? The jewel's brightness and the measured flows retain different warrants. Actual supply and governance must be investigated through their own evidence.

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C59-Cultural-Individuation-Epi-Logos-as-Culture|Cultural individuation]] returns an exteriorised measure to the culture which formed it. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C56-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins|Compassion]] receives its origins and affected lives as capable of answering, withholding and correcting the resulting act. [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD|Apportionment and economy]] follow who receives capacity, who bears cost and which office can alter that distribution.

Increasingly powerful mediations become more answerable when their derivation, affected worlds and returned consequences can change their use. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C51-Logos-Epi-Logos|Paradigm-level reflection]] places a disclosed pattern beside its enactment; [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C45-Operational-Parity|operative return]] carries the warranted correction or retention into the determining conditions of the next act. Planetary computation becomes a site of cultural and epistemic individuation where the people and worlds it coordinates can also change the terms by which they are coordinated. The achieved account remains useful through that return to its material supports, source authority and the lives which will encounter its consequences.
